changelog: Recalls long, structured notes reliably. A saved list of accounts or passwords is now split into focused passages (and its title is searchable), so asking 'what accounts do I have for Anthony?' finds and answers from the right line instead of coming up empty — a big help for smaller on-device models. On the phone, offline recall no longer cuts a note off at 140 characters. (Also from 0.1.41: vaulted notes stay off any cloud brain and are answered on-device.)
